note: GPU vs CPU frozen thresholds (fractions of pixels, mean abs error in 0..1). Tighten only; never above the ADR-0035 bounds.
exceptions_note: Frames where a star horizontal edge pair lies within 1/4096 px of a sample row, so vertex rounding flips a span of about 56 px; identical in the pure-Rust reference (GPU is byte-equal to it), so an encoder precision effect, not a kernel one. Each is capped by exception_cap.
